method: Apply the frozen five-family ordered origin list parser to each of 480 individually decoded native gun_preset_attack rows in the 133-blueprint coverage packet. Require exact origin index identity, backward typed five-name and five-float list pointers, 480 unique gear IDs, and byte-identical values for the original 25 frozen controls. Preserve all source offsets/float widths and native affix IDs.
interpretation_gate: These 480 source origin rows are field coverage across 133 blueprint candidates, not 480 fully validated public weapons or owned calibrated items.
